subtitle: Offline teacher, on device
promotional_text: A device-only teacher: four walk steps, a rising-column breath, and a private journal.
description: Amberwick is a complete offline teacher kept on your phone. Finish onboarding, follow Walk through four guidance steps, run Four Columns as a rising-column breath, choose a Range, and file a Tablet note. There is no account, no login, no cloud sync, and no remote AI. Your minutes and journal stay on the device.
app_review_notes: Amberwick is a fully offline attention-practice and private-journal app. Review flow: complete onboarding, open Walk and advance the four guidance steps, start Four Columns breathing, choose a Range, then save a Tablet note. No sign-in, network calls, camera, or photo library access.
